Dear Sir/Madam, 
Further to our letter dated 22nd July, 2026 and pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of 
the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) 
Regulation, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), It is hereby informed that audio recording of Earnings 
Conference Call with Analysts and Investors was held today i.e., 28th July, 2026 at 12:30 P.M. 
(IST) for Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and year 
ended 31st March, 2026 is available at https://www.csm.tech/investor/financials/quarterly-
results/2025-26 on the Company’s website. 
Transcript of the same shall be submitted separately. 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
For CSM Technologies Limited
